{#- Header language switcher. Links the current page to its counterpart under each per-language site root emitted by the deploy publisher (`/` = en, `/es/`, `/ca/`, `/hu/`). Dependency-free: pure server-rendered anchors, no script and no external asset. The language set, current language, and default flag come from docs/conf.py html_context; the per-page hrefs are computed from the page's relative path to its own language root. -#} {%- if cadrumo_docs_languages -%} {#- Relative path from this page to its current language root (e.g. '../' or ''). -#} {%- set _root = pathto(master_doc) -%} {%- if '/' in _root -%}{%- set _root_uri = _root.rsplit('/', 1)[0] ~ '/' -%}{%- else -%}{%- set _root_uri = '' -%}{%- endif -%} {#- The shared base holding every language root: the current root for the default (en, served at the base) build, one level up for a localized subdir build. -#} {%- set _docs_base = _root_uri if cadrumo_docs_language_is_default else _root_uri ~ '../' -%}
{%- for _lang in cadrumo_docs_languages -%} {%- if _lang.code == cadrumo_docs_default_language -%} {%- set _href = _docs_base ~ pagename ~ '.html' -%} {%- else -%} {%- set _href = _docs_base ~ _lang.code ~ '/' ~ pagename ~ '.html' -%} {%- endif -%} {%- if _lang.code == cadrumo_docs_language -%} {{ _lang.label }} {%- else -%} {{ _lang.label }} {%- endif -%} {%- endfor -%}
{%- endif -%}
